title: Data and figure scripts for "Local B-site chemistry controls oxygen-vacancy energetics in Ca–Ce–Ti–Mn perovskites for thermochemical hydrogen production"
description:
Processed data, figure scripts, and rendered figures for: M. Kumar, N. Ali, M. D. Witman, S. Zhai, J. E. Miller, I. Ermanoski, E. B. Stechel and R. B. Wexler, Local B-site chemistry controls oxygen-vacancy energetics in Ca–Ce–Ti–Mn perovskites for thermochemical hydrogen production, J. Mater. Chem. A, 2026, DOI: 10.1039/D6TA06895B.

The archive holds the SCAN+U oxygen-vacancy formation energies, the crystal-feature-model and defect graph neural network predictions, the thermogravimetric, stagnation-flow-reactor, and powder X-ray diffraction measurements, and one script per figure. The raw VASP inputs and outputs are in the NOMAD repository, DOI 10.17172/nomad.6d7e-hvb1.

Data and figures are licensed CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA); the code, READMEs, and configuration files are licensed MIT (LICENSE).
notes: Supported by the U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy, Fuel Cell Technologies Office, Award Number DE-EE0010733, through the HydroGEN Advanced Water Splitting Materials Consortium.
